7.4.4.13 Non-default sessions
The Dcm supports the ISO14229-1 [1] defined sessions. There are two kind of ses-
sions, the default session and the non-default sessions. In a non-default session the
S3 timer is used to detect inactive testers and if the timer elapses the default session
is entered.
[SWS_Dcm_01668] S3Server session timer support ⌈The Dcm shall support the
S3Server and start and stop this timer according to ISO14229-2 [13].⌋(RS_Diag_-
04249)
[SWS_Dcm_01669] Sessions and connections ⌈The Dcm shall start or stop the
S3Server according to ISO14229-2 [13] but only for the client on the DcmDslCon-
nection that requested the non-default session.⌋(RS_Diag_04249)
[SWS_Dcm_01670] Change to default session upon S3Server elapses ⌈If the
S3Server elapses, the Dcm shall switch back to default session.⌋(RS_Diag_04249)
